The issue described is related to the non-commutative multiplication of a SymPy `Poly` object with an expression. The problem arises because the multiplication operation is not symmetric in the way it handles the operands. Specifically, when the expression is on the left side of the multiplication, the result is not evaluated into a `Poly` object, but rather remains as an unevaluated product.
